facts.fact: On 3 March 2026 PN-RAVEC handed the 13 communes of Conakry secured, harmonised registers and printed forms, the birth register among them, which its deputy national coordinator said would cover more than 95% of the communes' needs for registering civil status events in Conakry in 2026.

note: The document does not say registration is on paper only; it states that paper registers and forms were supplied to meet the year's registration needs. The printed forms include the burial authorisation certificate; no death register is named.
